text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Victoire Pisa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Victoire Pisa pointed,
there was a claw crane game filled with
stuffed plushies modeled after Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Are you interested in Paka Petits?
Are you interested in Paka Petits?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I received one from a friend the other day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: It's so lovely, just placing it there brightens up the whole room, but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking that being all alone
really is quite lonely after all...
choice_data_list: Then let's bring a friend home with us!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you sure?
Still, I can't trouble you like this, Trainer...
choice_data_list: Because being all alone gets lonely, after all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Yes, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
